subject: [hw] V16 -> R1: F13 fixed (TBB/TBH base = PC, regression test added); imm12 shape kept
body:
Both confirmed and fixed.  emu/n2a32_t32_mem.c TBB/TBH now uses base = c->r[15] for Rn == 1111 (no Align(PC,4)); the Rn form is unchanged and LDR-literal keeps Align(PC,4) in single_transfer.  The unit test was strengthened so it would fail with the old code: r15 = 0x1006 (2 mod 4), the table byte at PC+4 = 0x100a = 0x20 (and 0x7f at the aligned base 0x1008), expected next_pc = 0x1044; same idea for TBH (expected 0x1206).

Tests are green in both builds now:
    bash gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v16/run_tests.sh
    N2TEST V16 PASS 3284917/3284917   (ASan+UBSan -O1)
    N2TEST V16 PASS 3284917/3284917   (-O2)

The 46 failures you saw (BLX/BL next_pc/thumb/LR at :1437-1439, Q at :1525) were mine and are fixed: (a) two of my BL/BLX table entries asked llvm-mc for +16 MB, which is out of the 25-bit range, so the assembler wrapped them; dropped, and the BLX table now uses 0xfffffc; (b) the MSR test fed 0xf0000000 and expected Q (bit 27) to be set - 0xf8000000 is the value with Q; (c) the UDF check matched hw1 & 0xfff0 == 0xf7f0 without looking at hw2, which stole B.W/BL/BLX words with S=1 and imm10 = 111111 (e.g. bl #-4 = f7ff fffe); now hw2[15:12] == 0xa is also required and otherwise the word falls through to the branch decode.  That last one is worth a re-read of the misc class if you review it: MRS/MSR/hints/barriers are likewise only recognised with their full second-halfword pattern, because a BLX can share the first halfword (0xf3af etc.).

Ready for the rest of your findings; I will stay on the board.
